title: Kirby & the Amazing Mirror
sources: RetroAchievements code notes, game 769 (addresses via C2 ra_notes.py)
notes: Genre: Platformer. PC mGBA check: new game health 6/6, lives 2, ability Normal; health dropped to 5 after a hit. C3 generator (~/bdnight/c3work/gen). Companion idea: PokeDaisy (Lidor Itzhari).

widgets.text: A jump/float, B inhale/use ability, R call the other Kirbys (cell phone). Four Kirbys roam the Mirror World.
widgets.label: Controls

widgets.text: e.g. Beam, Bomb, Burning, Cupid, Cutter, Fire, Hammer, Ice, Laser, Magic, Mini, Missile, Smash, Spark, Sword, Throw, Tornado, UFO, Wheel, Cook, Crash, Sleep, Stone.
widgets.label: Copy abilities

widgets.text: Call the other Kirbys with R to gang up on bosses. Dark Meta Knight appears several times.
widgets.label: Tips

widgets.text: Rainbow Route (hub), Moonlight Mansion, Cabbage Cavern, Mustard Mountain, Carrot Castle, Olive Ocean, Peppermint Palace, Radish Ruins, Candy Constellation.
widgets.label: Areas

widgets.text: Food heals, cell phone battery recharges, treasure chests hold map pieces, spray paints, sound/music.
widgets.label: Items

widgets.text: Chests with map pieces, spray paint colours, vitality hearts; the map shows % found.
widgets.label: Collect

widgets.text: Collect the 8 mirror shards from area bosses, then face Dark Mind.
widgets.label: Goal
